title: Distinguishing graphs with simple spectrum by homomorphism counts
summary: We study which graph classes determine every graph with simple spectrum up to isomorphism by homomorphism counts from their members. We show that such a class has unbounded treewidth and Euler genus and contains a graph with the complete graph on seven vertices as a minor. To prove these conditions, we construct pairs of non-isomorphic cospectral graphs with simple spectrum, each bipartite, nonsingular and of maximum degree at most six.
